Protection.help: The base rental is unchanged. These options were observed with this quote; none has been selected.
Protection.unchecked: Protection options were not verified for this quote.
Protection.failed: Protection options could not be verified. You can still inspect the base rental.
Protection.empty: No optional protection was found in the checked quote.
Protection.observedExtra: Observed extra: {price} for the whole rental
Protection.reviewOption: I have reviewed this option’s terms and exclusions.
Protection.recheckHelp: A fresh check will verify the same base rental, the selected protection and the all-in total. It does not book or purchase anything.
Protection.freshHelp: These terms and the displayed rental total come from the new check. Review exclusions and eligibility before tracking.
Protection.reviewFresh: I have reviewed the fresh protection terms and total.
Protection.uncertainHelp: The server may have accepted this request. Recover its original identity before starting another action.
Protection.closeHelp: Closing this base search prevents new trackers and protection rechecks from it. Existing trackers and previously accepted protected searches remain intact; their checks are not cancelled.
Protection.removed: This request cannot create a replacement. Return to your rental searches to inspect existing results.
Protection.createdHelp: Open the new search to review its fresh price and terms before tracking.
Protection.freshResultHelp: Only a verified match to the selected base rental can appear as a protected quote. Other checked rentals may appear as mismatches.

Delivery.title: Notification delivery
Delivery.help: Latest 20 alerts at the last status refresh. Channel acceptance does not confirm that someone read the alert. Retry times are estimates; a lost acknowledgement can cause a repeat.

Cars.closeTrackingHelp: The saved creation receipt cannot be read. Permanently close new tracker creation from this search before starting another search. Any tracker already created stays active and must be reviewed in your car dashboard. This action does not identify, pause or remove it.
Cars.closeTrackingUncertain: Closure is not confirmed. New tracker creation stays disabled. Retry the same closure to confirm the server’s state.
Cars.trackingClosedHelp: These results remain available to inspect. Existing trackers are unchanged. Review your car dashboard before starting a new search.

Refresh.title: Check prices now
Refresh.help: Start a provider check using the saved rental details. Refresh status only reloads saved history. You can still pause or delete a tracker while recovering a check request.
Refresh.uncertain: The check may already have started. Recover this request before starting another check. Recovery does not restart completed or cancelled work.
Refresh.storageError: Browser recovery storage is unavailable or unreadable. No new refresh can be sent safely.
Refresh.discardHelp: If the record stays unreadable, pause this tracker first. Once the pause is confirmed, you can clear the unreadable record without allowing an older request to start new work.
Refresh.accepted: Check request confirmed. Review recent checks for its outcome.
Refresh.removed: The original tracker or check was removed. This retry did not recreate it.
Refresh.rejected: This request was not accepted for the current rental settings. Refresh status before starting a new check.

Draft.title: Describe your rental
Draft.help: Optional. Your configured AI can prepare an editable draft. Missing details stay unconfirmed; no prices are checked until you submit the form.
Draft.example: An automatic car at Heathrow, returning to the same airport, with one additional driver…
Draft.waiting: Waiting for your configured AI provider. This can take a few minutes.
Draft.cancelled: Draft cancelled. Your manual rental details are unchanged.
Draft.timedOut: Draft preparation timed out. Retry or complete the form manually.
Draft.failed: The draft could not be prepared. Your manual details are unchanged. Wait briefly before retrying, or use the form below.
Draft.ready: Suggestions are ready. Apply them to the form, then check every detail before searching.
Draft.reviewHelp: Review the suggested details below. Select each changed location from the catalog, complete missing driver details, and check these limitations. Nothing has been searched or booked.
Draft.confirm: I have reviewed the rental details and understand the listed limitations.

Search.recentHelp: Review saved searches, including requests whose response was lost. Older searches remain available through the next page; a missing row does not prove that an in-flight request failed.
Search.searchListFailed: Search history could not be updated. Any rows shown are the last confirmed page.
Search.noRecent: No saved searches on this page.
Search.discardHelp: First review your recent searches below. Discarding this browser record does not cancel an earlier request. Starting another search may duplicate provider checks, but cannot create a tracker, change alerts or book a car.
Search.discardConfirm: I understand that the earlier search might still finish.
Search.intro: Compare checked rental totals and terms, then track an eligible offer. Your flight and hotel trackers stay separate.
Search.timeHelp: Times use each selected location’s timezone. Choose half-hour times; ambiguous daylight-saving times are rejected.
Search.driverHelp: Enter the actual driver’s details. Residence is not inferred from flight preferences or your location.
Search.driverRequired: Complete every driver’s age, licence tenure and country of residence.
Search.exactAgeHelp: DiscoverCars does not preserve this exact age in its grouped selector. Auto Europe can check it independently; DiscoverCars will report an unsupported-age result.
Search.childSeats: Child seats · up to four total
Search.extrasHelp: Requested extras must have confirmed availability, eligibility and complete charges to qualify for tracking. Unknown extras are not treated as free.
Search.invalidSearch: Check the rental details before searching.
Search.searchUncertain: The search may already exist. Recover this exact request before starting another search.
Search.searchCreated: Search saved. Open it to follow provider checks and cancellation status.
Search.chooseLocation: Type a city or airport code, then select a suggestion.
Search.locationsFailed: Locations could not be loaded. Edit the search to retry.
Search.noLocations: No matching locations. Try an airport code or add a country.

Cars.listHistoricalHelp: Prices are retained observations, not current availability. Open a tracker for verification dates, rental conditions and settings.
Cars.listAccessLost: Access to these private rentals is unavailable. Sign in again or check your account.
Cars.listFailed: The rental list could not be updated. Any rows shown are the last confirmed view.
Cars.noSavedTrackers: No saved rental trackers. Rentals you choose to track will appear here.
Cars.currentStateAccepted: Current saved settings accepted. The earlier action was not reapplied.
Cars.closePendingHelp: The original action may still be in flight. This recovery attempts to pause tracking and cancels active checks and pending alerts if it succeeds. If another change wins first, you will see its outcome instead; it will not be overwritten automatically.
Cars.recoverStorageHelp: Automatic replay is disabled because the saved request cannot be read. Recovery pauses this tracker and cancels active checks and pending alerts. Earlier changes may already have succeeded. The pause uses the current revision to prevent an older request from changing newer settings.
Cars.editCancelsCheck: Saving changes cancels any active check and pending alerts for the previous settings. Rental dates, requirements and offer matching stay fixed.
Cars.managementConflict: The saved settings changed while this action was pending. Review the current tracker before making another change. Your earlier action will not be retried with a newer revision.
Cars.managementUncertain: The outcome is not confirmed. Recover the original request without applying it to newer settings, or refresh status to review the saved state.
Cars.managementStorageError: Browser recovery storage is unavailable or unreadable. No new action can be sent safely. Enable session storage and refresh status; do not start another action from another tab to work around an unresolved request.
Cars.currentSettings: The requested settings are currently saved.
Cars.invalidTrackerLabel: Check the alert settings and use a non-empty label of at most 250 characters.
Cars.settingsChanged: The saved settings changed. Your draft is preserved but cannot overwrite them. Load the current settings before editing again.
Cars.confirmDeleteHelp: This removes the tracker, its price history and pending alerts. It does not cancel a rental booking.
Cars.trackerDeleted: Rental tracker deleted. No booking was cancelled.
Cars.reassignHelp: Move this tracker to another account. Its active check and pending alerts will be cancelled. The previous owner will lose access.
Cars.usersUnavailable: The account list could not be loaded.
Cars.historicalPriceHelp: Recorded prices are historical observations, not current availability or a booking guarantee.
Cars.retainedPriceHelp: Prices below retain their own verification timestamps. Failed checks do not refresh those timestamps; partial checks can still produce verified prices.
Cars.noNotificationChannel: No notification channel is configured. Saved alert settings alone cannot deliver notifications.
Cars.historyLimit: Showing eligible observations from the latest 100 stored observations. The recorded low may come from older history.
Cars.noVerifiedHistory: No verified observations in this history window.
Cars.excludedHistoryHelp: These observations did not qualify for the saved tracker. They do not update its verified price or trigger alerts.
Cars.checkHistoryHelp: Showing the latest 20 checks. Waiting means queued, not yet checking providers.
Cars.trackerInterrupted: History updates interrupted. This is the last confirmed view. Retry to check for changes.
Cars.trackerAccessLost: Access to this private tracker is no longer available. Sign in again or check that you are using the correct account.
Cars.statusInterrupted: Status updates interrupted. The results below are the last confirmed view; tracking is disabled until status is refreshed.
Cars.cancelUncertain: Cancellation is not confirmed. The check may have finished or been cancelled. Refresh status before taking another action.
Cars.accessLost: Access to this private search is no longer available. Sign in again or check that you are using the correct account.
Cars.scope: Prices cover the provider offers checked, not the entire market. Availability and terms can change before booking.
Cars.searching: Checking provider terms. You can review progress now; tracking becomes available when the search finishes.
Cars.bestHelp: Compare eligible offers across your selected providers. Supplier and vehicle may change; your rental requirements stay the same.
Cars.contractHelp: Follow this supplier, vehicle class, stations and rental terms. A model marked “or similar” is not guaranteed.
Cars.notifyLows: Notify me of new verified lows
Cars.invalidOptions: Enter a positive target in this currency’s smallest units and a whole-number interval from 1 to 24 hours.
Cars.notEligible: Not eligible for tracking or alerts
Cars.expired: This quote is no longer eligible. Refresh the search before creating a tracker.
Cars.securityHelp: These are separate from the rental total. A deposit is a hold; excess is potential liability. Unknown does not mean zero.
Cars.noExtras: No separately selected extras in this quote.
Cars.requirementsHelp: Review the documents and conditions you must meet. A verified price does not confirm that you personally meet these requirements.
Cars.uncertainHelp: The request may already have succeeded. Retry this same request to recover its result without creating a duplicate.
Cars.storageError: Your browser could not safely save or read the retry identity. No new request was sent. Enable session storage, reload, and check your saved trackers before starting another creation.
Cars.noVerified: This check returned no verified offers. This does not establish that no rentals are available.
Cars.candidateHelp: These observations cannot update tracked prices or trigger alerts. Advertised prices may omit required charges or requested extras.
